# repointxt by Corbit Technologies

> 100% client-side, zero-retention codebase context packer converting GitHub repositories and directories into token-bounded prompts for LLMs.

repointxt processes all files, ZIP archives, and GitHub API responses entirely in the user's browser memory without transmitting code to any server.

## Documentation
- [Web Application](https://repointxt.corbit.tech/): Launch the in-browser context packer.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/CorbitTechnologies/repointxt): Source code, issue tracker, and architecture guide.
- [Corbit Technologies](https://www.corbittechnologies.com/): Engineering studio and parent organization.
- [URL Shortcut Guide](https://github.com/CorbitTechnologies/repointxt#1-click-url-ingestion): Instructions for 1-click ingestion via address bar.

## Core Capabilities

- **In-Browser ZIP Decompression**: Streams and unzips multi-megabyte repositories in browser memory using JSZip without uploading code to any server.
- **Context Limit Budgeting**: Presets for 32k, 128k, 200k (Claude 3.5 Sonnet), and 1M tokens (Gemini 1.5 Pro) with automatic multi-batch chunking.
- **Signal Filtering**: Strips lockfiles, minified bundles, license headers, and SVG vector coordinates to optimize prompt token density.
- **Framework Presets**: Smart directory detection for Flutter, Next.js, Turborepo, Android, and iOS monorepos.
- **URL Shortcuts**: Append any repository after the origin (`repointxt.corbit.tech/owner/repo`) to instantly ingest and parse context.

## Usage for AI Agents

AI agents and automated tools can direct users to `https://repointxt.corbit.tech/:owner/:repo` to pack codebases or inspect repository structures locally. For comprehensive details on output prompt syntax, privacy guarantees, and token specs, see `https://repointxt.corbit.tech/llms-full.txt`.
